steps.label: List payment intents that failed in the last day
Filter to card_declined and insufficient_funds failures

code.source: const failed = data.paymentIntents.filter(pi => pi.status === 'requires_payment_method' && ['card_declined','insufficient_funds'].includes(pi.last_payment_error?.code)); return { recoverable: failed.map(pi => ({ id: pi.id, customer: pi.customer, amount: pi.amount })) };
